summary.en: A filter arrangement describes the samples available to reconstruct color.
summary.zh-cn: 滤色排列描述用于重建颜色的采样。

boundary.en: X-Trans and Bayer describe color sampling; X-Trans is not a third semiconductor technology alongside CCD and CMOS.
boundary.zh-cn: X-Trans 与 Bayer 描述彩色采样。X-Trans 不是与 CCD、CMOS 并列的第三种半导体技术。

en: A conventional Bayer array repeats over 2 × 2 samples; X-Trans uses a 6 × 6 pattern. Reconstruction estimates missing color components from those samples. CMOS describes the sensor technology, while X-Trans describes sampling. A different layout alone cannot determine the quality or style of a finished photograph.
zh-cn: 常见 Bayer 阵列以 2 × 2 采样区块重复，X-Trans 使用 6 × 6 排列，重建过程据此估计缺少的颜色分量。CMOS 描述传感器技术，X-Trans 描述采样方式，仅凭排列不同不能决定最终照片的质量或风格。

sources.supports: Bayer 2 × 2 and X-Trans 6 × 6 color-sample layouts, a separate description from semiconductor technology.
